title: New Year Gold Dedication Campaign

CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE,
Section 1, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
File No.: C.518Y
S. P. D.
Date February 10, 1939

Subject New Year Gold Dedication Campaign. CHIN

Made by D.I. Pan Lien-pih Forwarded by

With reference to Special Branch report dated
January 25, 1939 and the memo of the D.C. (Special
Branch) relating to the New Year Gold Dedication
Campaign, the "News Digest(譯報)", a foreign owned
local Chinese-language daily, published on February 10
a notice to the effect that "up to January 31, 1939,
a total of $5,127.64 has been received and remitted
through the Bank of China." No mention is made to
whom the money has been remitted, and enquiries made
at the newspaper office brought forth an evasive
reply and that the money had been dispatched for
refugee relief. This does not appear to be the
truth because, according to information from a
confidential source, the money has actually been
remitted to the headquarters of the New Fourth Army
operating in the areas abutting the Shanghai-Nanking
Railway line.

"The Standard," "The Ta Mei Pao", and "The Shun
Pao", foreign owned local Chinese-language dailies,
have also received small donations from various
individuals and because of the smallness of the sums
they were handed to the "News Digest" and included in
the sum of $5,127.64 as published by the latter
paper.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH）

日期 1939年2月10日

主题 新年献金运动。CHIN

由 督察潘连璧 制作 转呈

关于1939年1月25日的特务科报告以及特务科副总监有关新年献金运动的备忘录，外商拥有的本地中文日报《译报》（News Digest）于2月10日刊登了一则通告，大意是“截至1939年1月31日，共计收到5,127.64元，已通过中国银行汇出”。文中未提及款项汇往何处，向报社查询后得到含糊其辞的答复，称该笔款项已汇出用于难民救济。这似乎并非实情，因为据秘密线报，该笔款项实际上已汇往在沪宁铁路沿线地区活动的新四军总部。

《文汇报》（The Standard）、《大美报》（The Ta Mei Pao）和《申报》（The Shun Pao）这几家外商拥有的本地中文日报也收到了来自个人的小额捐款，由于金额较小，这些款项被转交给《译报》，并计入该报公布的5,127.64元总额中。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科）

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 897 Station, Date January 25, 1939.）

Subject New Year Gold Dedication Campaign in progress

Made by D.I. Pan Lien Pih Forwarded by C. Crawford O.O

In the middle of January 1939, a contribution campaign known as the "New Year Gold Dedication Campaign" (新年獻金) was launched under an atmosphere of utmost secrecy by members belonging to the local cultural circles (women's and vocational), who have communistic and leftist leanings. The object of promoting this campaign is to bring the local Chinese citizens into the practice of thrift and of contributing the money which might otherwise be spent unnecessarily in social items between relatives and friends during the new year period. The date for the start of this campaign has been set between January 16 and 31, 1939, during which period the people in general may send in their contributions to the offices of any of the four foreign-owned local Chinese-language dailies, namely the News Digest (譯報), the Standard (文滙報), the Ta Mei Pao (大美報) and the Shun Pao (申報). Those donors will be issued with a receipt and their names will be published in a special column of the dailies in due course.

Searching enquiries have thus far failed to ascertain the true identities of the prime movers of the campaign, but it has been learned that memiographed sheets (specimen attached) have been printed for dissemination amongst relatives and friends. These sheets contain instructions as to the procedure to be adopted in this gold dedication campaign and is as follows :-

1) Persuade your relatives and friends to dedicate the amount of money they may spend by indulging in

主题 正在进行的新年献金运动

由 督察潘连璧 制作 经 C. Crawford O.O 转呈

1939年1月中旬，一场被称为“新年献金”（新年獻金）的募捐运动在极度保密的气氛下，由具有共产主义和左翼倾向的本地文化界（妇女界和职业界）成员发起。推广此运动的目的是促使本地中国市民养成节俭习惯，并将春节期间原本可能浪费在亲友间社交应酬上的钱款捐献出来。此次运动的开始日期定为1939年1月16日至31日期间，在此期间，公众可将捐款送至任何一家外商拥有的本地中文日报报社，即《译报》（News Digest）、《文汇报》（The Standard）、《大美报》（The Ta Mei Pao）和《申报》（The Shun Pao）。捐款人将获得收据，其姓名将在适当时候刊登在这些日报的专栏中。

尽管经过深入调查，迄今仍未能查明该运动主要发起人的真实身份，但获悉已印制了油印传单（样本附后）并在亲友间散发。这些传单包含了进行此次献金运动的程序说明，内容如下：-

1) 劝告您的亲友捐出他们因沉溺于

social items usually connected with the new year
period.
2) Contributions may be sent to either the Shun Pao,
the News Digest, the Ta Mei Pao or the Standard,
all of which have been designated as receiving
agents.
3) Receipts will be issued by the newspaper offices
concerned and the names of the contributors will
be published in due course. The names of the
contributors may be kept out of the papers if so
desired.
4) On January 31, 1939, the date for the termination
of the campaign, the total sum received by the
various newspaper offices in connection with the
present campaign, will be delivered to a bank
already designated for the purpose.
5) The Gold Dedication Campaign commences on New Years
Day and will conclude on January 31, 1939.
It is to be noted that these memiographed sheets
make no mention of the purpose to which the money collected
will be used, but according to information received from
reliable sources, the money in question will ultimately be
remitted to the Headquarters of the New Fourth Army
through a reliable bank by the four local Chinese dailies
mentioned.

通常与春节相关的社交应酬所花费的金额。
2) 捐款可送至《申报》、《译报》、《大美报》或《文汇报》，这些报纸均被指定为收款代理。
3) 相关报社将出具收据，捐款人姓名将在适当时候公布。如有需要，捐款人姓名可不登报。
4) 1939年1月31日，即运动结束之日，各报社在此次运动中收到的款项总额，将交付给为此目的而指定的银行。
5) 献金运动于元旦开始，至1939年1月31日结束。
值得注意的是，这些油印传单并未提及所筹款项的用途，但据可靠消息来源称，上述四家本地中文日报最终将通过一家可靠的银行把这笔钱汇往新四军总部。
